SELECT cash_equivalents_usd + us_government_debt_usd - reported_reserve_fv_usd AS value FROM reserve_reports WHERE report_date='2025-06-30'

WITH coverage AS (SELECT report_date,100.0*reported_reserve_fv_usd/issued_sbc AS pct FROM reserve_reports WHERE report_date IN ('2025-05-31','2025-06-30')) SELECT (SELECT pct FROM coverage WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') - (SELECT pct FROM coverage WHERE report_date='2025-05-31') AS value
